verdict.rationale: Founders Workbench is Goodwin's free tool suite (Capital Calculator, Liquidation Calculator, Document Driver). A tool suite like this could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows deterministic calculators and document generation, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
